description: Operational contact metadata for source-records public-records requests. Recipient fields are intentionally conservative: do not invent an email address when the current custodian must be verified before sending.

states.notes: Use the Division contact path for source-side confirmation of ENR write-in allocation, reporting-unit geometry/crosswalks, turnout-field semantics, historical baselines, CVR availability, and administration-context records.
Use the statewide Election Division request first. County office routing should be used only if the state confirms no statewide same-grain precinct/subcounty export exists.

states.primaryCustodian: Nevada Secretary of State Elections Division and county clerks/registrars
states.notes: Use the county-clerk contact path for the 14 Nevada jurisdictions outside loaded Clark, Washoe, and Humboldt CVR review coverage.

states.primaryCustodian: New York State Board of Elections and county boards of elections
states.notes: Use NYSBOE FOIL for state-maintained records and the County Board Roster for county-equivalent local result, turnout/voter-history, geometry/crosswalk, and administration-context records.

states.primaryCustodian: South Dakota Secretary of State Elections Division
states.notes: Use the public-records path to request the certified 2024 General Election canvass/static export or a reconciling official county-level result payload. County auditors are fallback custodians if the state cannot provide a statewide certified export.
